```plato
//==
// # Sample patterns in space
//
// The spatial counterparts, for scattering through a volume rather than over
// a region: the same parameters with a third axis. The closed-form families
// generalize directly; Poisson-disk and blue noise stop at 2D, because their
// background grid has to be written to as it is filled and this vocabulary's
// arrays are immutable (see `sampling.library.plato`).

// Jittered-grid scattering through a volume: one point per grid cell,
// displaced from the cell center by JitterAmount in [0, 1].
type JitteredGridPattern3D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds3D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector3;
    JitterAmount: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}
```
